title: Reconcile token billing gaps between streaming aggregator and batch ledger
creator: Avery Chen
description: Investigate and implement a reconciliation flow that eliminates persistent discrepancies between the real-time streaming metering pipeline and the canonical batch billing ledger. Current symptoms: customers report small but persistent token count mismatches (0.1–2%) that compound over high volume accounts; quotas and rate-limit counters sometimes diverge after interrupted streaming sessions or client reconnects. Goal is <0.05% delta for total token counts per customer per day and deterministic quota enforcement across streaming and non-streaming sessions.
acceptance_criteria: A nightly reconciliation job runs and produces explanation diffs for any customer with >0.05% delta or >500 token delta
Reconciler can attribute discrepancies to a single cause class (stream cut, duplicate events, missing finalization) in >=85% of cases
Quotas and rate limits use reconciled counters within 10 minutes of job completion for affected accounts
No regression in ingestion throughput (streaming pipeline P99 latency < 400ms) after changes
New metric meter.reconcile.unresolved_count stabilized below 1% of accounts after two weeks
implementation_notes: Add deterministic end-of-session markers from the realtime router for all streaming sessions (session_end event with final_token_counts)
Enhance streaming event ids to include client-provided sequence and server-assigned event_uuid to detect duplicates reliably
Implement an idempotent reconciler that consumes both streaming ledger and batch ingest outputs and writes reconciliation records to billing_reconciliations table
Introduce a lightweight delta-apply API used by quota enforcer to patch counters for affected accounts so enforcement is consistent post-reconcile
Feature-flag changes: live reconcile enabled for pilot accounts only; full rollout gated on metric objectives and SRE signoff
test_plan: Unit tests for duplicate detection logic with permutations of out-of-order, retried, and truncated streams
Integration tests that simulate mid-session disconnects and ensure session_end arrives and reconciler resolves counts
Synthetic workload: 3 day backfill comparing reconciler output vs ground-truth generator across 1000 synthetic customers
Chaos test: inject dropped events and delayed finalization to validate reconciler classification and idempotency
End-to-end billing smoke: run reconciler against staging ledger and verify invoices (sample accounts) match expected token totals
monitoring_and_alerting: new grafana dashboard: Billing → Reconciliation Overview (daily delta histogram, top N customers by delta)
alert: billing.reconcile.unresolved_spike > 50 accounts in 1h → P0 oncall
on-call runbook entry: how to temporarily disable reconciler delta-apply and trigger manual repair scripts
updates: 2026-02-18 — Avery Chen: Created ticket after customer support flagged recurring small deltas for three high-volume customers. Initial spike to measure magnitude across accounts completed (see linked dashboard).

2026-02-22 — Ravi Patel: Spike findings: two dominant classes of mismatch identified — (1) streaming sessions that never emit a session_end due to client crashes, (2) duplicate streaming events from retry semantics. Quantified impact: ~0.6% of sessions affected but concentrated in top 2% of customers.

2026-02-26 — SRE sync: agreed on approach to add server-side session_end emission and to rely on event_uuid for deduping; SRE requested no-change to existing ledger schema. Decided to implement reconciler as separate service to avoid coupling to ingestion path.

2026-03-01 — Design review: presented delta-apply API and idempotent reconciler design. PM and Billing signed off on acceptance criteria. Noted potential edge case: sessions that span billing boundaries (midnight UTC) require special attribution rules.

2026-03-04 — Dev progress: implemented session_end emission and event_uuid in streaming router (behind FF). Added end-to-end test harness that replays retries and out-of-order events. Initial unit tests green.

2026-03-07 — QA: integration test failures observed when reconciler attempts to apply deltas while quota enforcer is concurrently updating counters. Mitigation: implement optimistic compare-and-swap and backoff in delta-apply API.

2026-03-09 — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1427 (reconciler service skeleton + migration adding reconciliation table). Requesting review from @mona (billing) and @sam (SRE).
2026-03-11 — Pilot plan: enable live reconcile for 5 pilot accounts with known deltas. Monitor reconcile.unresolved_count and reconcile.attribution_accuracy for 72h before wider rollout.

2026-03-12 — Blocker noted: legacy clients using HTTP/1.1 long-polling do not reliably send session_end; adding compatibility shim on router to timeout and synthesize session_end for these clients. Assigned to @Diego for router patch.

2026-03-12 — Next steps: finish optimistic CAS in delta-apply, run synthetic 72h backfill, iterate on reconciler attribution rules for boundary-spanning sessions, schedule SRE signoff for rollout on 2026-03-18.
